name: ModelVariant756_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant756_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (header 756's entry, an extension of the header-766 entry: the same gouraud trail, stars, sparks and light columns, plus a cloud of animated smoke puffs, a debris burst and a ring of embers in front of the slot. The smoke texture row is taken from the second puff's frame, as retail does); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-756 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant756_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.

The smoke texture row is taken from the second puff's frame, as retail does); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-756 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant756_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
